Hi Shiny !!


Today, I am looking to call several times the same renderUI in my app.

When I looked at this topic on forums, it is mentioned that calling a renderUI with the same Id is not possible.

Thus, I am wondering if there is a solution to do it or absolutely not ? With html class ?

Thank you very much for your idea !!!

Cha

Here  is my very simplified code :)

library("shiny")
runApp(list(
  ui = bootstrapPage(
    uiOutput("choix"),
    uiOutput("valid"),
    uiOutput("valid")
  ),
  server = function(input, output) { 
   
    temp = reactiveValues(temp = 0)
   
    output$choix <- renderUI({
     
      numericInput("exchoix","",value = temp$temp)
     
    })
   
    output$valid <- renderUI({
     
      actionButton("valid","valider")
     
    })
   
   
    observe({
      if(is.null(input$valid)){}
      else{
        if(input$valid != 0){temp$temp <- 1}
      }


     
     
    })
   
   
  }
 
))
